FOCUSED REINVESTMENT | G2 proposed loop -> G4 controls -> G6 evidence
[S] Management model: gross-profit growth plus headcount discipline
    -[D:claim]-> capacity to reinvest in platform and merchant acquisition.
|
+-- MARKETING CONTROL
|   +-- [S] 2023: tighten paybacks; then increase POS/offline investment.
|   +-- [S] 2026 Q1: about 40% of performance-marketing dollars in Europe.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: pause some US channels/geographies to test incrementality.
|       +-- [S] S&M grew 14%; some spending shifts to Q4.
|       `-- [I] Test results absent; no estimated causal lift is available.
+-- AI AND PEOPLE
|   +-- [S] Q1 2024: AI assisted over half of merchant support interactions.
|   +-- [S] Q1 2025: teams must assess AI before seeking more headcount.
|   +-- [S] Q3 2025: headcount flat/down for over two years.
|   +-- [S] Q2 2026: choose model capability with cost discipline.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: Sidekick AI costs compressed subscription gross margin.
+-- VOLUME AND RISK
|   +-- [S] Q2 2025 GMV +31% reported versus +29% constant currency.
|   +-- [S] Q2 2026: constant-currency GMV +29-30% for five quarters.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2025: onboarding experiments raised payment losses.
|       `-- [S] Management said payment loss rates were moving back down.
`-- [I] AI productivity, acquisition returns and risk need joint assessment;
    the excerpts do not isolate each contribution to growth or margins.
